body.message:
Thank you for the update. No problem at all. I’m still very interested in Downtown Views 2, and if the availability, long-term rate, and payment terms are suitable, I would be interested in renting it for a longer period.

In the meantime, could you please check if you have any studio or 1-bedroom apartments currently available in JVC or any other good location at a reasonable monthly rate?

For now, a studio or 1-bedroom would be perfectly fine for me until the end of September. I would just like to know the exact rate for this month and whether the rate would remain the same next month or change.

Please feel free to share any suitable options you have. Thank you for your help.
